Run a workload in its own workspace daemon, provisioned at runtime

## Usage

```console
coder run [flags] <workspace> [command...]
```

## Description

```console
Provision a new workspace daemon from the shape the workspace's template declares, without a workspace build. Each workload gets its own identity. The command, if any, is run by the new daemon and its output is streamed.
  - Start a workload and run a command in it:

     $ coder run my-workspace -- coder identity

  - List the workloads of a workspace:

     $ coder run --list my-workspace

  - Remove a workload:

     $ coder run --remove workload-1a2b3c4d my-workspace
```

## Options

### --shape

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|
| Type     | <code>string</code> |

The workload shape to clone, by agent name. Only needed when the template declares several.

### --name

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|
| Type     | <code>string</code> |

A name for the workload. It becomes the name of its workspace agent.

### -l, --list

| Property | Value             |
|----------|-------------------|
| Type     | <code>bool</code> |

List the workspace's workloads instead of starting one.

### --remove

| Property | Value               |
|----------|---------------------|
| Type     | <code>string</code> |

Remove the named workload instead of starting one.

### --scope

| Property | Value                     |
|----------|---------------------------|
| Type     | <code>string-array</code> |

A permission the workload may use on your behalf, as an API token scope such as workspace:read. Repeat it for several. Without any, the workload can do nothing in Coder.

### --no-wait

| Property | Value             |
|----------|-------------------|
| Type     | <code>bool</code> |

Return as soon as the workload is requested, and print its ID.

### --timeout

| Property | Value                 |
|----------|-----------------------|
| Type     | <code>duration</code> |
| Default  | <code>10m</code>      |

How long to wait for the workload to start and its command to finish.

|----------|--------------------------------------------------------------------|
| Type     | <code>[name\|status\|shape\|sponsor\|scopes\|identity\|pod]</code> |
| Default  | <code>name,status,shape,sponsor,scopes,identity</code>             |

Columns to display in table output.

### -o, --output
